## Convx 2.0.3 Nightly

Pre-release build from `main`. Nightly builds may be unstable. Please report issues in the Convx GitHub issue tracker.

### Which APK?
- **`convx-2.0.3-nightly.apk`**: for almost every phone (64-bit).
- **`convx-arm32-2.0.3-nightly.apk`**: only for 32-bit-only phones such as the Galaxy A13 that say "app not compatible" with the normal APK.

### New in 2.0.3
- New 32-bit (arm32) APK for phones that could not install 2.0.x.
- Spotify login: the sign-in page no longer identifies itself as an embedded WebView, which Spotify was rejecting.
- Discord login: the token is now read through an iframe when Discord removes page storage, fixing logins that hung on the Discord page.

### Also included from 2.0.2 and 2.0.1
- Fixed a playback crash caused by the playback-stats tracker.
- Playlist import and library fixes, feed refresh and pagination fixes, and reliability improvements across playback, navigation, lyrics, and appearance settings.
